agentBuildPrompt: Create a Nature city construction team with five independent quadrotor robots: surveyor, road paver, two builders and planter. Assume unlimited resources; do not create a hauler. Use parameterized futuristic high-rises, low-rise blocks, six tree generators and a connected multi-level interchange. Keep right-hand traffic, tangential same-direction merges, ramp grades below 8%, and at least 5 m structural clearance. Builders wait for their district's road acceptance; planting waits for building acceptance. Use exclusive task ownership, retryable messages, actual command results and world readback. Work pause keeps messaging active; only unstarted tasks may be released. Keep all construction inside the surveyed area.
